_method: Every claim checked against seo-tools/runbook/_facts.md (NexFortis facts) or an independently verified named primary source (third-party stats, verified live via firecrawl 2026-06-22). Prior 2026-06-18 06a-factcheck.json (PR-107 era) superseded: its stats were never inserted into the current draft, so 3 fresh stats were re-verified live and inserted.
fabrication_scan: NONE — no client counts, named client results, testimonials, invented prices, guarantees, awards, or fixed link-count / ranking-date promises. Link-building capabilities (outreach, guest posting, digital PR, niche/editorial links, backlink audit + toxic-link disavow, packages, white-hat) written as NexFortis's approach/process (the pillar already lists link building as a stated service), not as a track record. The draft explicitly DECLINES to promise a fixed number of links or a guaranteed ranking.
